answer: Audits are logged in cipher, queued in falcon, and sparrow publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 96 identities per epoch. A farm of 359 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1855 identities would post 769 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
